metadata.description: A personal marketplace of skills published by Samah Alshrief. Every plugin here is authored, maintained, and versioned by the marketplace owner.

plugins.name: website-accessibility
plugins.description: Audit websites for accessibility barriers (WCAG 2.2, ARIA, color contrast, keyboard, screen readers) and produce a prioritized report with per-issue WCAG citations and specific fixes.

plugins.name: systematic-literature-review
plugins.description: Guide a rigorous systematic or scoping review following PRISMA 2020  -  protocol, search-string design, deduplication, screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias, PRISMA flow diagram.

plugins.name: data-management-plan
plugins.description: Generate a funder-compliant Data Management Plan (NSF, NIH, Wellcome, ERC, Horizon Europe, MRC, NSERC, ARC) with FAIR narrative, repository selection, and cost estimation.

plugins.name: reproducibility-audit
plugins.description: Audit a research repo for computational reproducibility  -  env pinning, seeds, data provenance, notebook hygiene, container hygiene, CI, README. Severity-ranked report with specific fixes.

plugins.name: ipeds-explorer
plugins.description: Answer higher-ed IR questions using IPEDS via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal  -  peer comparisons, enrollment/finance trends, graduation rates, net price. Fast one-turn answers.

plugins.name: openalex-bibliometrics
plugins.description: Bibliometric analysis via OpenAlex  -  free open scholarly graph. Author profiles, institution profiles, citations, co-authorship, funders, OA share. Free alternative to Scopus/WoS.

plugins.name: dashboard-storyteller
plugins.description: Turn a chart, table, or dashboard tile into a plain-English narrative for an executive or board audience. Captions, executive paragraphs, three-bullet talking points, or full briefs.

plugins.name: grant-proposal-checker
plugins.description: Compliance and completeness pass on a research grant proposal (NSF, NIH, ERC, Horizon Europe, Wellcome, DOE, DOD)  -  page limits, biosketch format, DMP presence, budget justification, required sections.
